topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I wandered through the gallery, each step echoing softly against the high ceilings. The air, heavy with the scent of fresh paint, embraced me like an old friend. Suddenly, I paused, my gaze caught by a figure in the corner. They stood under a harsh spotlight, their skin a living canvas where my latest series had found a new home. The strokes, the colors—they matched my work so intimately, as if they had sprung from the same well of inspiration. I felt a surge, not of anger, but of something warm and gentle. Approaching them, I whispered, "You have captured the essence of my art in a way I never could, with your own body. Thank you." Their eyes met mine, and for a moment, the world around us faded, leaving only the beauty we had both created.
